title: Lamb Korma Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired lamb curry made with tender lamb, rich spices, and a hint of sweetness from the raisins.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pan and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add onion, ginger, and garlic.
Cook until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add korma spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add raisins and cook for an additional minute.
Return lamb to pan and stir to combine.
Pour in heavy cream and stir to combine.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until lamb is tender, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper, if desired.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
